lines.zh: 游过黑暗，阴影紧随其后

lines.en: Swim against the flow, avoiding monsters.

lines.zh: 夜晚才是它真正的舞台
茶色鱼鳍扫过花木林的水面。
lines.en: A tea-brown fin sweeps the blossom-wood water.

lines.zh: 它顺着溪流巡过 16 格边界。
lines.en: It patrols its sixteen-block border along the stream.

lines.zh: 悬在花木林水底，鳞色如茶。
lines.en: It hovers in blossom-wood water, scales tea-brown.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢划圈，水草跟着晃。
lines.en: Its tail circles slowly and the weeds sway.
Blossom shadows fall on its brown scales.

lines.zh: 它张合着嘴，吃水面的碎花瓣。
lines.en: It lips the petals off the surface.
Notices the player, waiting for an opportunity.
Player appears, it doesn't let go.
Observes the player, looking for weaknesses.
Readies itself as the player approaches.
It becomes alert as soon as the player appears.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，寻找攻击机会
lines.en: Observes the player, looking for an attack opportunity.
It starts moving as the player approaches.

lines.zh: 玩家一出现，它就准备攻击
lines.en: It prepares to attack as soon as the player appears.

lines.zh: 你在岸边，它浮起来看你。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; it rises to look.

lines.zh: 它绕着你投下的影子游。
lines.en: It swims around the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 你伸手，它退到水草后面。
lines.en: You reach in; it slips behind the weeds.

lines.zh: 它把嘴探出水面，盯着你的手。
lines.en: It pokes its mouth out, eyeing your hand.

lines.zh: 隔着水，它的眼睛圆而黑。
lines.en: Through the water its eye is round and black.

lines.zh: 你走近，它顺时针打了个转。
lines.en: As you near, it loops once clockwise.

lines.zh: 它认出你是这片水的新客。
lines.en: It marks you as the new arrival in this water.

lines.zh: 它贴着你脚边的浅滩绕圈。
lines.en: It circles the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 身体受了伤，游得慢了点。
鳞下渗血，我沉到石缝里。
lines.en: Blood seeps under my scales; I sink to the stone crevice.
Come close, watch out for my触角！
Come on, watch out for me!

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅起泥，撞散了它。
lines.en: Your boot stirs the mud and scatters it.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，才能交配繁殖。
寻找伴侣，才能繁衍后代。
lines.en: Find a mate to have offspring.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，才能延续后代。
lines.en: Find a mate to continue offspring.
Sniff my tea color and scare you!
Stay back, or you’ll regret it!
Stay away from me, I’m scary!

lines.zh: 不要看我的眼睛，你会害怕的！
lines.en: Don’t look at my eyes, you’ll be scared!
Scared by my tea color, huh?

lines.zh: 你伸手试水，我便顶你指节。
lines.en: Reach into the water, and I butt your knuckles.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是你的噩梦！
准备吓跑你想接近的家伙！
lines.en: Ready to scare off the one who dares to get close!

lines.zh: 我来吓走你这个入侵者！
吓吓这个想靠近我的家伙！
lines.en: Scare the one who dares to get close!
Make that guy stay away from me!

lines.zh: 吓跑这个想要靠近我的家伙！
lines.en: Scare off the one who dares to get close!

lines.zh: 有东西靠近水边，它转向。
lines.en: Something nears the water; it turns.

lines.zh: 它嗅到岸上来的陌生气息。
lines.en: It tastes a strange scent from the bank.

lines.zh: 它盯住水面上晃动的倒影。
lines.en: It fixes on the wavering reflection above.

lines.zh: 枯叶落水，它误认作来客。
lines.en: A dead leaf falls; it takes it for a visitor.
It tightens its fins and drifts bankward.
The ripples break, and it is alert.
It sets its mark on the shallows.

lines.zh: 保持距离，不然你会害怕的！
lines.en: Stay away, or you’ll be scared!

lines.zh: 这片水底，怪物都不敢来。
lines.en: No monster dares enter this stretch of water.

lines.zh: 你离我越远越好，否则你会后悔的！
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you’ll regret it!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你会害怕的！
lines.en: Don’t get close, or you’ll be scared!

lines.zh: 茶色鳞片一摆，你最好退开。
lines.en: One flick of my tea-brown scales; better step back.

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你会害怕的！
lines.en: Stay away, or you’ll be scared!

lines.zh: 保持距离，否则你会害怕的！
lines.en: Stay away, or you’ll be scared!
It puts itself between you and the weeds.

lines.zh: 它鼓起身子，想显得更大。
lines.en: It puffs up to look bigger.
One tail-flick and the mud billows up.
It butts your ankle with its flank.

lines.zh: 它悬停着，尾巴绷得很紧。
lines.en: It hangs still, tail held taut.

lines.zh: 水面下，它一动不动地对着你。
lines.en: Under the surface it faces you, motionless.
It muddies the water and hides itself.

lines.zh: 它数着你的呼吸，等破绽。
lines.en: It counts your breaths, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 用你肥厚的身躯撞碎它们！
lines.en: Ram them with my thick body!
The mud at the pond bottom backs me up.

lines.zh: 我甩尾一撞，水花替你疼。
lines.en: I snap my tail; the splash aches for you.
Use my body to block you!
Tea-colored scales flash at the surface.

lines.zh: 茶色的背鳍竖起来，快退。
lines.en: My tea-brown dorsal fin is up — back away.
I won't let you get close!

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则后果自负！
lines.en: Stay back or suffer the consequences!

lines.zh: 它顶你的膝盖，力气不小。
lines.en: It rams your knee with real force.

lines.zh: 它跃出水面，撞向你的手。
lines.en: It leaps out and strikes your hand.

lines.zh: 滑腻的鳞身蹭过你的脚背。
lines.en: A slick scaled flank grazes your foot.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的指头又松开。
lines.en: It nips your finger and lets go.

lines.zh: 花木林的溪水泛起茶色。
一尾茶鲤在花谷水里翻了个身。
lines.en: A chagoi rolls over in a blossom-valley pool.
Among the weeds a scale flashes.

lines.zh: 它顺水漂进这片安静的池塘。
lines.en: It drifts down into this quiet pond.

lines.zh: 花瓣落水，它从底下冒出来。
lines.en: Petals fall, and it surfaces beneath them.

lines.zh: 茶色的影子在浅水里成形。
lines.en: A brown shadow takes shape in the shallows.

lines.zh: 它绕着池底的石子转了一圈。
lines.en: It makes one turn around the pond stones.

lines.zh: 安静的活水里多了一尾茶鲤。
lines.en: One more chagoi in the quiet living water.
